faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Quick answers to the most common questions.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Open the app address in your browser. Your account was created by NeoSleep: use the email you were invited with.
steps: Type your email.
Type your password. The eye icon shows what you typed.
Leave “Remember me” ticked on your own device so you don't have to sign in every day. Untick it on a shared computer.
Tap “Sign in”.
login.tip: Tip: add the app to your phone's home screen from the browser menu (“Add to Home screen”).

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.lead: On the sign-in screen tap “Forgot your password?”.
steps: Type the email of your account.
Tap “Send reset link”. Within a few minutes you will receive an email with a link.
forgot.tip: No email? Check your spam folder. For security the app doesn't say whether the address exists.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.lead: The link in the email opens this screen. It is valid for 1 hour and works once.
steps: Type the new password.
Type it again to confirm.
Save it. From now on sign in with the new password.
reset.tip: Link expired? Request a new one from “Forgot your password?”.

patients.title: Your patients
patients.lead: “Patients” in the menu lists the patients assigned to you. Each row shows their documents, studies and the next step.
steps: Search by name.
Add a new patient.
Open a patient's record by tapping the name.
The button under “Next step” takes you straight to what's missing: the patient's QR, or the device tracking.

patientAdd.title: Add a patient
patientAdd.lead: Tap + on the patient list. The panel on the left fills in as you type.
steps: First name and last name.
Sex.
Date of birth.
Email and phone: the patient receives forms and visit reminders there.
Tap “Add patient”.
patientAdd.tip: You only need the name to save. Complete the rest later with the pencil in the record.

patientDetail.title: The patient record
patientDetail.lead: Everything about one patient on one screen.
steps: Tabs: Details, Notes, Documents, Studies, Device and History.
“Next step” tells you what is pending and offers the action to resolve it.
“Documents and studies” shows how complete the record is.
Book a visit (calendar icon). The pencil next to it edits the patient's data.

psgFill.title: Polysomnography: record the results
psgFill.lead: Must have: without polysomnography there is no diagnosis or treatment plan. In the record open “Studies” and tap “Fill in” on Polysomnography.
steps: Study date (it cannot be in the future).
Status: from “Ordered” to “Results received” and “Interpreted”.
AHI score, minimum SpO2 (%) and ODI from the report.
Your interpretation.
Tap “Save”.
psgFill.quote: Polisomnografía: confirma el diagnóstico y su severidad.

psgResult.title: Polysomnography: the result
psgResult.lead: Once saved, the study appears in “Studies” with its values and the severity on the AHI scale.
steps: Attach the lab report (PDF, JPG or PNG) with +. Attached to the study, the file completes it.
The study card: date, AHI, minimum SpO2 and ODI.
The severity: <5 normal, 5–15 mild, 15–30 moderate, >30 severe.
psgResult.tip: The clinical criteria are in the Care protocol, in Resources.

visit.title: Book a visit
visit.lead: In the record tap the calendar icon (“Book visit”). The patient and you as the doctor are already filled in.
steps: Date.
Time, in your clinic's time zone.
Duration.
Notes for the visit (optional).
Tap “Book”.
visit.tip: If the patient has an email, they receive a confirmation and a reminder, and can confirm or say they can't attend. You see their answer in the Panel.

qr.title: QR for the patient
qr.lead: The patient fills in their own forms on their phone: consent, medical history and the STOP-Bang questionnaire. Tap “QR for the patient” in the record.
steps: The forms the QR includes: only the ones still pending.
The patient scans the code with the phone camera.
“Copy link” to send it by message instead.
qr.tip: The link works once and expires in 24 hours. If it expires, create a new QR.

documents.title: Documents: where to fill in what
documents.lead: The “Documents” tab gathers the consent and the medical history. Done items get a green tick.
steps: The progress: how many documents are complete.
Informed consent: by QR, printed, or upload the signed scan.
The medical history has 4 sections: History, STOP-BANG, Examination and TMJ.
“Fill in” to complete a section yourself during the visit.
Send the patient everything pending by email (the link works for 7 days).
documents.tip: Complete = every item ticked in “Documents and studies”.

order.title: Order the device (DAM)
order.lead: In the record open “Device” and tap +. The order has 3 steps.
steps: The steps: treatment set-up, dental records (scans) and summary.
Maximum retrusion (MR), in mm.
Maximum protrusion (MP), in mm.
The mandibular advance range is calculated for you.
Go on with the arrow. In the summary check everything and send.
order.tip: If your clinic's address is incomplete, the order says so at the top: contact NeoSleep to fix it before ordering.

tracking.title: Track the order
tracking.lead: In “Device” each order shows its number and where it is. The patient list shows the same under “Next step”.
steps: The order number.
“Ordered”: the lab is making the device.
“Received”: the device has arrived and you can book the delivery visit.
tracking.tip: The lab gives the delivery date, usually about 15 days after the dental records (Care protocol).

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.lead: All your visits, with the patient and the time.
steps: Month calendar: tap a day to go to it.
Switch between day, week and month.
“Today” takes you back to the current day.
Tap a visit to see it, move it or cancel it.
+ books a new visit.

panel.title: Panel
panel.lead: Your home screen: what is waiting for you today.
steps: Search for any of your patients.
Today's visits, studies to interpret, incomplete records and patients in treatment.
Your patients by stage, from new to in treatment.
Upcoming visits.
“Needs your action”: results to interpret, unsigned consents, patients who can't attend.
panel.tip: The Panel is being switched on account by account. If you don't see it yet, the app opens on “Patients”.

faq1.q: The password reset email doesn't arrive.
faq1.a: Check spam. The link works for 1 hour; request a new one from “Forgot your password?”. If it still doesn't arrive, contact NeoSleep.
You only see the patients assigned to you. Search by first or last name, and check that no filter is on.

faq1.q: The patient says the QR doesn't work.
faq1.a: The QR works once and for 24 hours. Create a new one with “QR for the patient”, or use “Copy link” and send it by message.

faq1.q: Can I use the app on my phone?
faq1.a: Yes, in the browser. Add it to the home screen to open it like an app.

faq2.q: Where do I enter the polysomnography?
faq2.a: In the record, “Studies” tab → “Fill in” on Polysomnography. Attach the lab report with “Upload file”.

faq2.q: Where do I see how the device order is going?
faq2.a: In the record, “Device” tab, or under “Next step” in the patient list.

faq2.q: The order says my clinic's address is incomplete.
faq2.a: Contact NeoSleep: the clinic's address, postal code, phone and email are needed to deliver the device.

faq2.q: Does the patient find out about the visit?
faq2.a: Yes, if they have an email: they receive a confirmation and a reminder, and their answer shows up in the Panel.
